dish: Awamori tasting (Ryukyu Premier kūsu) on the distillery tour
address: 12-17 Suzaki, Uruma, Okinawa 904-2234, Japan (head office 3-22-8 Koja, Okinawa City)
w: Founded in 1846, Shinzato is one of the oldest operating awamori distilleries in Okinawa, now run by the seventh-generation owner. It offers a roughly 45-minute factory tour combining traditional craft and modern technology, and has won the awamori grand prize at the All Japan sake competition.

dish: Special Burger — two charcoal-grilled patties, bacon and fried egg
w: Stand By Me-themed burger joint in a converted former on-base house near the Sunabe Seawall, serving coarse-ground, filler-free charcoal-grilled patties since 2007. Its Special Burger stacks two patties, thick bacon, a fried egg and cheese.

dish: Roast beef and steak at Okinawa's first pizza house
n: Pizza House Honten, Urasoe (ピザハウス 本店)
w: Founded in 1958 (its founders served Okinawa's first pizza), this American-style restaurant near Minatogawa Stateside Town is known for its roast beef and steaks. The main branch reopened in a 1950s-diner-style renovation on 15 March 2026 with the stated aim of becoming a '100-year restaurant'.

n: Miyanchi STUDIO & COFFEE, Okinawa City (みやんち STUDIO&COFFEE)
w: Red-tiled café and studio opened in 2012 in the hills of Okinawa City, produced by THE BOOM singer Kazufumi Miyazawa to share Okinawan folk music and food. Its signature is kara-soba, a soup-less Okinawa soba Miyazawa devised after eating a version on Ishigaki.

dish: Beni-imo kokutō zenzai (purple-yam and brown-sugar shaved-ice zenzai)
n: Tsurukame-dō Zenzai, Yomitan (鶴亀堂ぜんざい)
w: Zenzai shop near Zakimi Castle serving Okinawa-style zenzai — kintoki beans simmered for six hours under fluffy shaved ice. Its signature uses Yomitan's own beni-imo purple sweet potato, which dyes the ice violet under a brown-sugar syrup.

dish: Hanaori soba with soft-bone sōki and simmered pork belly
w: Yomitan's flagship Okinawa-soba house on Prefectural Road 6, founded in 1988 by a former French-cuisine chef. The signature bowl tops medium-thin wavy noodles in pork-bone broth with soft-bone sōki and long-simmered pork belly; tebichi and liver-and-nira soba are also on the menu. It reopened after a renovation in 2026.

dish: House-roasted espresso drinks and homemade cheesecake
n: Zhyvago Coffee Works Okinawa, Chatan (ZHYVAGO COFFEE WORKS OKINAWA)
address: 1F Distortion Seaside Bldg, 9-46 Mihama, Chatan, Okinawa, Japan
w: Seafront coffee stand in American Village launched in 2015 as a local brand pairing Okinawa's west coast with American West Coast coffee culture. It brews beans from its own Zhyvago Coffee Roastery nearby, and its homemade cheesecake is the usual pairing.
